name: com.huantansheng.easyphotos.ui.EasyCameraActivity
description: EasyPhotos (Joker-Fu’s photo picker) opens this camera screen when a user chooses to take a photo or video; it uses either the phone’s camera app or EasyPhotos’ built-in camera and returns the captured media to the picker.
disableEffect: Users can no longer take a new photo or video from EasyPhotos, although choosing existing media remains available.
